= paragraph-precedence(1)
:doctype: manpage
:revdate: 2026-10-06
:manmanual: Parser checks
:mansource: acdc

== Name
paragraph-precedence - retain explicit verbatim paragraphs

== Synopsis

[source,python]
P01 code ;; <1>

<1> Source marker.

//-

[listing]
P02 code:: <1>

<1> Listing marker.

//-

[literal]
P03 code::: <1>

<1> Literal marker.

//-

[source,text]
P04 first line <1>
P05 continuation ;; <2>
P06 following line <3>

<1> First line.
<2> Continuation.
<3> Following line.

//-

[source,text]
* P07 bullet <1>
. P08 ordered <2>
P09 term:::: <3>

<1> Bullet stays code.
<2> Number stays code.
<3> Term stays code.

//-

[source,text]
NOTE: P10 admonition <1>

<1> Admonition stays code.

//-

[source,text]
P11 before <1>
* P12 bullet <2>
P13 after <3>

<1> Before list-looking text.
<2> Bullet within source paragraph.
<3> After list-looking text.

//-

* Parent.
+
[source,text]
P14 attached ;; <1>
+
<1> Attached source paragraph.

//-

P15 ordinary:: Still a description list.

//-

[source,text]
P16 opening <1>
----
[[apparent-id]]
[.apparent-role]
== Apparent heading
image::missing.png[]
----
// Apparent comment
P17 closing <2>

<1> Paragraph content starts before the apparent delimiters.
<2> Content stays together until the blank line.

//-

Term:: Parent description.
+
[source,text]
P18 attached to description ;; <1>
+
<1> Description-list continuation.

//-

[source,text]
----
P19 real delimited source ;; <1>

P20 real delimited source after blank <2>
----
<1> Opening delimiter still selects a block.
<2> A delimited block keeps its blank lines.

//-

[verse]
  P21 verse:: *Bold*
  * P22 line, not a list.
  NOTE: P23 ordinary verse text.

After the verse.
